name: kit-area
about: LumaKit area (lumakit.md 2.7, lumakit-modules.md row 10). kit-area on EggStarGalaxy; its layer places orderCube/orderSphere/orderCylinder (a kind from code with enter/inside/leave callbacks), slowCube and windCube overlapping (kinds from kit/area/slow.json, wind.json) and sideCube (kit/area/side.json, a Side camera 1500 along x). The script puts the player in each (MR::setPlayerPos). three_shapes_order: enter, inside, leave once each in order for each shape; contains true inside, false at the start. slow: the kit sets the game's walking resist 0.5. wind: the kit pushes the player 8 a frame along z (160 over 20 frames). overlap: in both, resist 0.5 and pushed. side_camera: the main camera 1500 from the player inside, back to the game's after leaving. mod_off: the mod taken out (its kinds end, the camera given back). WAITING: classes.alias, AreaObj::getManagerName row and the KitArea AreaObjMgr row, the factory facts of the area rows, LUMA_OUT on MR::calcCubeRotate (F); mods.kit_read, ref<AreaObj> (K).
